title: Read-only staging audit: database checks pass; platform isolation unverified
summary: Confirmed scoped read-only PostgreSQL 17.11 and empty application schema. Recorded default ACL risks, absent catalogue dependencies, inaccessible management settings and precise approval gates.

changes.detail: Added fresh evidence matrix, PostgreSQL 17 assessment, backup prerequisites and prioritized remediation gates. No hosted or runtime modifications.
